name: doviello_settler
description: a Doviello Settler, a young barbarian pioneer: shaggy brown hair, blue war paint on his face, a grey-white fur coat with dark stripes and a bone-tooth necklace, dark leggings with white fur wraps and brown laced boots, a huge brown backpack on his back topped with a rolled brown bedroll and a pair of pale antlers, a tin pot hanging from the pack on the screen-left, and a long crooked wooden walking staff with a few pale bone charms tied near its top in his LEFT hand (screen-right)
hands: the walking staff stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand on the screen-left side is an empty fist holding the backpack strap at his chest

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the walking staff is lifted up over the head with its top pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the walking staff cocked behind the head with its top hanging down behind the backpack, the empty right fist tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the walking staff is level, its top pointing to the lower-right
strike.4: contact: staff arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the walking staff cracking down-right like a club, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty right fist swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the walking staff carries on down until its top nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the shaggy hair trailing back, the backpack swinging
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the walking staff lifts back toward the upright ready angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty right fist flung out to the left, the staff arm thrown up and out), the backpack jolting
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the walking staff dipping, the empty right fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, the staff arm flung up, the empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward under the heavy backpack, head droops, the walking staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the walking staff's top resting on the ground, the empty right arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left onto the backpack, the walking staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground on top of the backpack, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the walking staff lies on the ground at the lower-right
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the tin pot swings
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the backpack under him, the walking staff on the ground beside him
